The '''Mark IV Decimator Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Droids of this model were deployed on the [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] ''[[Javelin (Harrower-class)|Javelin]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
